service.description: Retrieves active Meta-JSON layout tree, falling back to parsing the physical XML screen file on miss or stub detection.
Stores or updates a Meta-JSON workspace layout buffer safely.
Recursively processes FreeMarker templates (.ftl) by expanding include directives, or converts a layoutTree AST map into standard Moqui screen XML.
Compiles the Meta-JSON blueprint layout tree back into standard Moqui XML and writes it cleanly formatted to disk.
Renders a Moqui XML screen file off disk into native QMETA Meta-JSON AST using DefaultScreenMacros.qmeta.ftl.
